name: Comfy Cloud
summary: Run your Comfy Cloud workflows and save the results to a Selects project.

compatibility.selects: Requires the Panel UI kit v2, runShell, runScript and Node.js 22+ on PATH. Uses your own Comfy Cloud subscription and credits. macOS app integration tested with simulated Cloud responses; paid Cloud execution is not yet verified. No local ComfyUI runtime is needed.
